# A data pack with a recursive loot table added to a RUNNING server: the reloadable registries load, then the loot table
# validation throws and the reload keeps the old data (`/reload` and `datapack enable` print the failure).
#   scripts/command-diff.sh crates/mc-game/tests/fixtures/commands_corpus/reload_loot.txt
!addpack gametest/gtbadloot
reload
datapack enable "file/gtbadloot"
datapack list enabled
@bot loot give @s loot gtbadloot:recursive
